claims.description: Durable PR #2664 incident evidence records the exact head, eight authoritative paths, reported count of 31, and three base-only findings.
The deterministic fixture executes the workflow after a simulated normal main merge and excludes the fixture's base-only paths from the GitHub manifest.
Out-of-diff findings emit REVIEW_SCOPE_CORRUPTION and exit non-zero; in-diff findings retain their verdict behavior.
The latest fresh exact-head verdict on an unchanged-head rerun recovers to a clean authorization without commit churn.
Structural and security ratchets preserve trusted-base rules, bot identity, freshness, exact head, prompt-injection posture, and existing permissions.
A live read-only probe of PR #2664 reproduces the authoritative eight-path scope and identifies all three review findings as out of scope.
